paragraphs: We believe uncharted territory means new opportunities. We pioneered multi-specialty dental care over 40 years ago, setting a new standard for the practice of dentistry. We also originated the support model for multi-location practices by creating one of the first Dental Support Organizations (DSO).
Built by dentists for dentists, we continually raise the bar for what’s possible in the practice of dentistry by delivering healthy confident smiles for life.

We support doctors so they
can put patients first.

We create a better way to
practice dentistry.

We enable clinical autonomy and
empower our employees.
There’s a common bond between great dental practices at 42 North Dental where “quality seeks quality” as we build on the success of great practices and ensure a legacy of excellence.
Our affiliation process is straight-forward, flexible, and transparent.
Join the team who always has your back. At 42 North Dental, we’re a team of individuals who unite around the single purpose: setting the standard of quality and care in dentistry

“I’ve been with the company for 25 years and have purchased equity year after year. I feel it’s been key in advancing my financial success. I felt like I made the right choice on day one, and 25 years later, I know I’ve made the right choice.”
- Dr. Stephanie Payne, Regional Clinical Director
"Our partnership with 42 North Dental has helped us navigate current and future changes to ensure my family’s practice will continue as it has.“
- Dr. Craig Allen, Allen Dental Associates

When I sold my practice
to 42 North Dental, I really felt the weight of the world was off my shoulders. I was able to bring my practicing career to a close without disrupting the office or my patients. I felt relief, satisfaction, and that the practice was in good hands.”
- Dr. Kenneth Fink, Family Dental Practice of Newington

“As a dentist, I have support at all levels, so I can do what I love best, which is focusing on the dentistry and patient care. As an equity owner, I benefit from the success of the whole group in addition to my individual practice.”
- Dr. Joseph Capua, Gentle Dental Attelboro

"Early on, 42 North Dental told us while they were coming with all of the support systems, they were not going to try and change how we do dentistry.
Having been a dentist my whole life, I was happy to hear that. We Made the Right Decision.”
- Dr. Dean Cloutier, Partner, Dental Director, New Haven Dental Group

“From the first day of our affiliation, I felt extremely comfortable with all the support teams at 42 North Dental. It was clear to me that this organization cares about their providers and wants to help them succeed. I joined as an Associate and am now proudly the Dental Director of our Southbury location.”
- Dr. Stephen DiBenedetto, Dental Director, Southern CT Dental Group
" I would say that every element of my partnership with 42 North Dental has benefitted my patients and their overall care. What benefits the providers and practice truly does benefit the patient."
- Angela J. Santavicca, Dental Director, Santavicca Dental Professionals

CHARTING NEW COURSES

We believe uncharted territory means new opportunities. We pioneered multi-specialty dental care over 40 years ago, setting a new standard for the practice of dentistry. We also originated the support model for multi-location practices by creating one of the first Dental Support Organizations (DSO).

Built by dentists for dentists, we continually raise the bar for what’s possible in the practice of dentistry by delivering healthy confident smiles for life.
